# Timestamp

Convert Unix timestamps ↔ dates (ISO 8601, RFC 1123).

Category: Converters · ID: `timestamp` · Search terms: unix, epoch, date, time, iso8601, rfc3339

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui timestamp [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Timestamp or date (empty = now)

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--unit` | `auto`, `s`, `ms`, `us`, `ns` | `auto` | Unit. auto: by number of digits |
| `--tz` | text | `Local` | Zone. Local, UTC or an IANA name (America/Bogota) |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/timestamp`), so they are what the tool prints.

### iso-utc

Input:

```text
2026-03-15T08:30:00-05:00
```

Output:

```text
Unix (s):   1773581400
Unix (ms):  1773581400000
ISO 8601:   2026-03-15T13:30:00Z
RFC 1123:   Sun, 15 Mar 2026 13:30:00 UTC
UTC:        2026-03-15 13:30:00
Local time: 2026-03-15 13:30:00 +00:00 (UTC)
Relative:   in 73 d
Day:        Sunday, week 2026-W11, day 74 of the year
```

### millis-madrid

Input:


Output:

```text
Unix (ms):  1767225600123
```
